searchConfiguration.name: Direct use of View.visibility is prohibited
searchConfiguration.description:
Do not assign to View.visibility directly, either via the property (view.visibility = ..., visibility = ...) or via setVisibility(...). Use the extension properties from androidx.core.view instead: isVisible, isGone, isInvisible.
Example: // Bad binding.progress.visibility = if (isLoading) View.VISIBLE else View.GONE
// Good binding.progress.isVisible = isLoading
If a direct assignment is truly necessary, suppress this inspection with @Suppress("DirectViewVisibility") and leave a comment explaining why.
searchConfiguration.problemDescriptor: Don't set View.visibility directly. Use isVisible / isGone / isInvisible instead.
